Mani’ Cafe is unfortunately not a pleasant place to eat. There is no proper seating arrangement, so most people have to stand and eat. The only reason the place remains crowded is because there are very few other options nearby, so people end up coming here anyway.

The food quality is also disappointing. Most dishes are excessively oily, and I would strongly suggest avoiding the sabudana khichdi and pohe. The only somewhat acceptable item is the tea, but even that is inconsistent because a different boy prepares it every day, so the taste keeps changing.

Another issue is the poor crowd management. Beggars often approach and disturb customers, and the staff does not seem to take any responsibility to manage the situation. The worst part is the constant gutter smell, as the cafe is almost above a drain. Unfortunately, it feels like this issue will never be addressed due to negligence.

Happy Eating.
